Heat 0%Cold

Heat climbs the longer it burns (full in about 75 s) and smelts up to 3× faster. It takes about 3 minutes to cool, and above half heat it keeps smelting on stored heat alone.

Burn: stick 5 s · planks 15 s · log 30 s · coal or charcoal 80 s. Alloys take one of each input.

    An isometric block world. Climb cliffs, cut through meadows, build on any ledge you can reach.
